result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the page, primarily related to text truncation and card clipping in the horizontal scroll section.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off mid-word without an ellipsis, making it unreadable and unprofessional.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a max-width constraint so truncated text ends with '...' instead of breaking mid-word.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll row is visually clipped at the right edge, cutting off both the image and the restaurant name. While partial card visibility can hint at scrollability, the current clip ratio is too severe and hides critical information.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card peek width so approximately 20-30% of the third card is visible, enough to suggest scrollability while still showing a meaningful preview of the card content.
